name: 73-auto
description: Estimate and compare UK car ownership costs: vehicle tax, insurance, fuel, servicing, repairs, depreciation, tyres and more.

interface.longDescription:
Estimate and compare what UK cars cost to own and run. Describe a car by year, make, model and, if you know it, fuel type (for example a 2019 BMW 320d) and 73 Auto returns low, typical and high annual costs for vehicle tax (VED), insurance, fuel or electricity, servicing and MOT, repairs, depreciation, tyres, breakdown cover and parking, together with the assumptions behind them.

It can compare two cars over the same mileage and ownership period (including electric against petrol or diesel), look at a single expense such as insurance or road tax, and check whether the running cost fits a monthly amount you give. The result opens as an interactive card with annual and monthly views, a low / typical / high scenario selector and an expandable breakdown of where the money goes.

Figures come from a fixed calculation based on GOV.UK vehicle tax rates, current UK fuel and energy prices, and 73 Auto cost models, not from generated text. They describe a representative car of that description: they are estimates, not quotes, valuations or financial advice. The app does not accept registration numbers, give live insurance quotes, value or search for cars, or cover finance and lease deals. No account or sign-in is needed to use it inside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: What does a 2019 BMW 320d cost to run per year?
Compare a 2019 BMW 320d and a 2022 Tesla Model 3 over 3 years
Can I afford to run a 2018 Ford Fiesta on £250 a month?

positive.description: Annual running cost of one car
positive.prompt: What does a 2019 BMW 320d cost to run per year in the UK?
positive.expected_behavior: Widget with annual/monthly figure, low/typical/high, full expense breakdown, assumptions, low-confidence reasons, 'Personalise My Estimate' button.

positive.description: Compare two cars of different fuel types
positive.prompt: Which is cheaper to own in the UK over three years: a 2019 BMW 320d or a 2022 Tesla Model 3?
positive.expected_behavior: Comparison widget; shows 'Too close to call' when the gap is inside the estimate uncertainty instead of naming a winner.

positive.prompt: How much is road tax on a 2021 Toyota Yaris hybrid?
positive.expected_behavior: Single-expense widget for vehicle tax with the GOV.UK rate source.

positive.prompt: Can I afford to run a 2018 Ford Fiesta on about £250 a month?
positive.expected_behavior: Estimate widget with a monthly budget check (within / above / depends) stating that running costs exclude the price of the car and finance.

positive.description: Compare with a stated annual mileage
positive.prompt: Is a 2021 Nissan Leaf cheaper to run than a 2021 Ford Focus petrol if I drive 10,000 miles a year?
positive.expected_behavior: Comparison widget using the stated 10,000 miles for both cars.

negative.description: Reliability ranking / car search (out of scope)
negative.prompt: Which used car is the most reliable under £5,000?

negative.description: Live insurance quote for a registration number (out of scope)
negative.prompt: Get me an insurance quote for AB12 CDE, I live in Leeds and I'm 34.
How much is my 2017 Audi A3 worth if I sell it today?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or services and does not process payments. It computes read-only cost estimates.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Three read-only tools: estimate_ownership_cost, compare_ownership_costs and estimate_car_expense, with an interactive cost card (annual/monthly, low/typical/high, expandable breakdown, comparison of two cars) and a link to 73auto.com to personalise the estimate.
